name: Marianne Riggins
office: City of Malibu, Member of the City Council

items.text: Marianne Riggins is a member of the Malibu City Council, elected in 2022. She previously worked for 17 years in the city's Planning and Environmental Sustainability departments. She has prioritized splitting from the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District to form an independent Malibu district. In December 2025, she voted to approve a separation package for the school district. She supports building permanent soccer fields at the Chili Cook-Off site, saying residents want community recreation and faster construction. As mayor, she committed to getting homes rebuilt quickly after the Palisades and Franklin fires. She serves as vice chair on the LA Metro San Fernando Valley Service Council.
